root_idea.summary: The root centers on depletion: a substance, liquid, resource, or capacity is used up and brought to an end.
root_idea.development: The lexical field extends from draining a well or expelling blood and tears to drink running out, the mind being emptied by intoxication, and figuratively a disputant's proof being exhausted.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form IV perfect citation form أَنْزَفَ rather than the imperfect QAC lemma.

senses.definition: To become intoxicated; to have one's reason removed by drink.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic construction with عَنْهَا, this meaning is negated: the drink does not intoxicate or deprive its drinkers of reason. The sense is tied to one of the variant vocalizations represented in the supplied Form IV grouping.

senses.definition: For drink to be exhausted or depleted.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic construction, this meaning is likewise negated: the drink does not run out. It is an explicitly reported variant-reading interpretation of the grouped Form IV expression, not an additional occurrence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To drain or exhaust a liquid completely, especially by drawing water from a well little by little; also to have blood or tears entirely flow out.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The well usage concerns gradual removal of its water; the blood and tears usages describe their being completely drawn out.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A scoop or single drawing of water.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal usage for the amount taken in one scoop; its plural is نُزَف.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To exhaust or deplete a thing completely.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive Form IV usage described as stronger or more intensive than نَزَفَ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For a disputant's argument or proof to be exhausted, leaving him unable to continue his case.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative construction used of a person whose حجّة has come to an end in disputation.

lane_unit_coverage.note: The unit's exhaustion of a well and its water is represented under the liquid-draining meaning.
Pointer-only entry directing the reader to an example under another headword.

cautions: The single QAC Form IV group combines the vocalized forms يُنزَفُ and يُنزِفُ. The supplied Quran-focused evidence records variant-reading interpretations involving both intoxication and drink depletion, while the contextual English glosses render both occurrences as intoxication.
